title: MORE SETS ≠ MORE GROWTH
hook: MORE SETS ≠ MORE GROWTH
caption:
MORE SETS ≠ MORE GROWTH

Adding training volume only helps when your body can recover and adapt to it.

Start with a manageable number of high-quality sets, train them with enough intensity to stimulate growth, and monitor your performance and recovery.

If you’re progressing, recovering well, and maintaining good execution, there’s no need to add more.

Increase volume only when progress stalls and recovery is still strong.

#HypertrophyTraining #MuscleGrowth #ProgressiveOverload #StrengthTraining #aatfitness

title: The study tested seated vs lying curls for 12 weeks.
hook: The study tested seated vs lying curls for 12 weeks.
caption:
AND THE ANSWER IS...

→ A. Seated Curls

The study tested seated vs lying curls for 12 weeks. 

It found seated leg curls produced about 14% growth in hamstring muscle volume.

Lying leg curls produced about 9%.

That's over 50% MORE growth from SEATED LEG CURLS than lying curls.

The reason is simple: the seated position puts the hamstrings that cross your hip at a longer muscle length (STRETCH). 

This position taps into the biarticular, longer part of the hamstrings. The shorter muscle had the same growth in both lying and seated curls.
